title: AUEC: A Contract Layer for Verifiable Hybrid AI Execution
description: AUEC is a research pre-standard and reference implementation for bounded, verifiable hybrid AI execution. Version 0.36.0-prestandard adds isolated causal mutation controls for the U0 host-operation intersection and epistemic-admission guards, a pure executable authorization predicate with no external effect, and exhaustive checks over declared finite model domains. The Zenodo record-level license is Other (Open) because no single license applies to every deposited file; it does not replace the governing per-path licenses. Licensing is assigned by path: CC BY 4.0 for the specification, technical report, and narrative documentation; Apache-2.0 for separable schemas, TCK material, SDKs, bindings, and autonomous examples; AGPL-3.0-only for the reference runtime and gateway. Consult LICENSING.md and LICENSE_MAP.csv. This is not an adopted standard or production security certification. A2A conformance testing remains incomplete.
